chinese: 来，宝贝 — F4 聊天
pinyin: Lái, bǎobèi — F4 liáotiān
english: Lesson 1: Morning F4 Chat

speaker: 夏雨
chinese: 来，宝贝，喝点牛奶。
pinyin: Lái, bǎobèi, hē diǎn niúnǎi.
english: Come on, sweetie, drink some milk.
notes: 来 softens commands; 宝贝 is affectionate

speaker: 夏雪
chinese: 阿姨，你喜欢 F4 吗？
pinyin: Āyí, nǐ xǐhuān F4 ma?
english: Auntie, do you like F4?
notes: F4 = Taiwanese boy band from Meteor Garden

speaker: 刘梅
chinese: 喜欢呢，真的。
pinyin: Xǐhuān ne, zhēn de.
english: I do like them, really.
notes: 呢 adds a casual, affirming tone

speaker: 夏雪
chinese: 那您觉得 F4 帅吗？
pinyin: Nà nín juéde F4 shuài ma?
english: Do you think F4 are handsome?
notes: 您 = polite you; 帅 = handsome/cool

speaker: 刘梅
chinese: 我觉得吧，他们比 F1、F2、F3 都帅。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde ba, tāmen bǐ F1, F2, F3 dōu shuài.
english: I think they're even handsomer than F1, F2, and F3.
grammar: A 比 B 都 + Adj
notes: The joke: Liu Mei treats F4 like a numbered series (F1–F4) and doesn't realize F4 is the band's name — comedy gold

speaker: 夏雪
chinese: 那是什么乐队呀？
pinyin: Nà shì shénme yuèduì ya?
english: What band is that?

speaker: 刘梅
chinese: 那都是些老乐队。
pinyin: Nà dōu shì xiē lǎo yuèduì.
english: Those are all old bands.

speaker: 夏雪
chinese: 阿姨，您对流行音乐的历史还真有研究。
pinyin: Āyí, nín duì liúxíng yīnyuè de lìshǐ hái zhēn yǒu yánjiū.
english: Auntie, you really know your pop music history!
source: 00m34s_013_阿姨 您对流行音乐的历史.jpg
notes: 有研究 = colloquial praise: you really know about this

speaker: 刘梅
chinese: 那当然了，阿姨是老追星族。
pinyin: Nà dāngrán le, āyí shì lǎo zhuīxīngzú.
english: Of course! Auntie is an old-school fan.
source: 00m38s_015_邦当然六9 阿姨是老追垕族.jpg

chinese: 追星族
pinyin: zhuīxīngzú
english: fan / groupie — 追 chase + 星 star + 族 group
source: 00m38s_015_邦当然六9 阿姨是老追垕族.jpg

speaker: 夏雪
chinese: 阿姨，那您喜欢哪首歌呀？
pinyin: Āyí, nà nín xǐhuān nǎ shǒu gē ya?
english: Auntie, which song do you like?
notes: 首 shǒu = measure word for songs

speaker: 夏雪
chinese: 我喜欢那首《要定你》。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān nà shǒu «Yào Dìng Nǐ».
english: I like that song "Want You for Sure."
notes: F4 song reference; 《》 marks song titles

speaker: 刘梅
chinese: 我也喜欢这首。
pinyin: Wǒ yě xǐhuān zhè shǒu.
english: I like this one too.

speaker: 夏东海
chinese: 你们俩还有点臭味相投啊。
pinyin: Nǐmen liǎ hái yǒudiǎn chòuwèixiāngtóu a.
english: You two really are birds of a feather!

chinese: 臭味相投
pinyin: chòuwèixiāngtóu
english: Birds of a feather flock together
source: 00m58s_023_这叫不像一家人不进一家门.jpg
literal: Same foul smell, same direction — shared tastes (often playful)

speaker: 刘梅
chinese: 那当然了。
pinyin: Nà dāngrán le.
english: Of course!

speaker: 刘梅
chinese: 这叫不像一家人，不进一家门。
pinyin: Zhè jiào bù xiàng yī jiā rén, bù jìn yī jiā mén.
english: That's "like attracts like"!
source: 00m58s_023_这叫不像一家人不进一家门.jpg
idiom: 不是一家人，不进一家门
notes: Liu Mei playfully twists the classic idiom (不像 vs 不是)

chinese: A 比 B 都 + 形容词
pinyin: Tāmen bǐ F1, F2, F3 dōu shuài.
english: They are even more [adj] than B — 比 = than, 都 = even/all

speaker: 夏雪
chinese: 阿姨，那您唱两句。
pinyin: Āyí, nà nín chàng liǎng jù.
english: Auntie, sing a couple lines for us!

speaker: 刘梅
chinese: 那第一句词是什么来着？
pinyin: Nà dì yī jù cí shì shénme láizhe?
english: What were the first lyrics again?
source: 01m10s_025_那第亠 句词是什么来着.jpg
notes: 来着 = as I recall (casual past)

speaker: 刘梅
chinese: 我是骚动，我是爱情的暴风。
pinyin: Wǒ shì sāodòng, wǒ shì àiqíng de bàofēng.
english: I am the commotion, I am the storm of love!
source: 01m10s_025_那第亠 句词是什么来着.jpg
notes: Botched F4 lyrics — she's pretending to be a superfan

speaker: 刘梅
chinese: 爱主攻，不喜欢被动。
pinyin: Ài zhǔgōng, bù xǐhuān bèidòng.
english: Love taking the lead, don't like being passive!
notes: Second botched lyric line — more comedy

chinese: 下集：周渝民 — 背 idol 资料
pinyin: Xià jí: Zhōu Yúmín
english: Next: Liu Mei memorizes F4 trivia
